introduction: Patch registration (POST /workspaces/:slug/patches, single and batch, and afc patch add on top of it) resolves a patch branch to a local refs/heads/<name> ref in the workspace trunk. It looks at the local ref first, then the clone's origin tracking ref, then, only when PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin, the fork itself. It records how the branch was resolved in the hub.patch.create audit event.

glossary.PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE: Workspace variable defined by 20_fork_patch_sync. The exact, case-sensitive value origin means the fork is the authority for patch branches. Any other value, an unset variable or a lookup error means hub.
glossary.compare-and-swap create: git update-ref refs/heads/<name> <sha> <all-zero-sha>, which fails if the ref already exists.
glossary.resolution method: How a branch was found: local, origin_tracking or origin_fetch. The audit trail also uses skipped when skip_branch_check was true.
glossary.resolver hook: The hook defined in internal/workspace/branch_check_hook.go that replaces the old boolean BranchCheckFunc. It takes a context, slug and branch name and returns a resolution method and a classified error.
glossary.tracking ref: refs/remotes/origin/<name> in the trunk, the clone's copy of a fork branch.
glossary.trunk: The clone of the fork at <workspace_root>/<slug>/trunk. Patch rebuilds read only refs/heads/<branch> in it.
glossary.workspace lock: The per-slug lock taken with wslock.TryLock(slug) to serialise operations on the trunk.

requirements.title: Resolution order
requirements.rationale: A fork-only branch must get a local ref before the patch row is inserted, because rebuilds read only refs/heads/<branch>.

criteria.condition: a non-skipped registration names a branch whose refs/heads/<name>^{commit} resolves to a commit
criteria.action: report the resolution method local, write no ref, take no workspace lock and perform no fetch

criteria.condition: refs/heads/<name> does not resolve and refs/remotes/origin/<name>^{commit} resolves to a commit, in either PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE mode
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<name> at that commit and report the resolution method origin_tracking

criteria.condition: neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name> resolves
criteria.action: fetch that single branch from the fork and, if refs/remotes/origin/<name> then resolves to a commit, create refs/heads/<name> at that commit and report the resolution method origin_fetch

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact string origin
criteria.action: treat the workspace as hub mode: perform zero fetches and zero origin credential lookups, including when the branch exists nowhere
criteria.contract: A counting fetch stub and a counting credential-resolver stub both record 0 calls

criteria.condition: a registration request starts
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE once for that request using the parsing helper of 20_fork_patch_sync, so that a change of the variable takes effect on the next request

criteria.condition: the submitted name resolves only as a tag, a SHA or a remote-qualified name such as origin/x and not as refs/heads/<name> or refs/remotes/origin/<name>
criteria.action: reject the branch as not found, using fully qualified refs for every existence check
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with the not-found message of 21-REQ-4; no row inserted and no local branch created

criteria.condition: no branch-check hook is registered
criteria.action: accept the branch without any resolution, as before this spec

requirements.title: Creating the local branch
requirements.rationale: The local ref must be written without disturbing the trunk's working tree and must be safe against a concurrent hub push.

criteria.action: create the local branch only with update-ref refs/heads/<name> <sha> <all-zero-sha>, never with checkout, branch or reset, leaving the trunk's working tree and HEAD unchanged

criteria.condition: the compare-and-swap create fails because refs/heads/<name> now exists
criteria.action: re-run the resolution from step 1 and report the resolution method local
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 for the registration; the existing ref is not modified

criteria.condition: writing refs/heads/<name> fails for any reason other than the ref already existing
criteria.action: log the error with the slug and branch, insert no patch row and answer with an internal error
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

criteria.action: for any created local branch, point it at the tracking tip at the moment of creation and write no upstream tracking configuration

requirements.title: Single-branch fork fetch
requirements.rationale: Only the one requested branch is of interest at registration time; pruning and tags are sync's concern.

criteria.condition: resolution step 3 runs
criteria.action: run a go-git fetch of the trunk's origin remote with the single refspec +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name>, no tags, no pruning, and credentials from workspace.ResolveCloneAuth (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then none)

criteria.condition: the fetch returns git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate
criteria.action: treat the fetch as successful and continue with the tracking-ref check

criteria.condition: the fork does not have the requested branch and the fetch reports that no remote ref matches
criteria.action: classify the failure as branch not found on origin, create no local branch and insert no row

criteria.condition: the fetch fails for any reason other than the branch being absent on the fork (unreachable fork, authentication failure, transport error)
criteria.action: log the error text, create no local branch, insert no row and not echo the error text in the response
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message origin fetch failed and error type origin_fetch_failed

criteria.condition: origin credential resolution fails
criteria.action: skip the fetch, create no local branch and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message failed to resolve origin credentials

criteria.action: decide that a branch is not found on origin from a typed go-git error or by listing the remote's refs, and never from matching on error text alone

requirements.title: Error for a branch found nowhere
requirements.rationale: Clients need one stable message regardless of mode.

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration names a branch that no resolution step finds (steps 1 and 2 in hub mode, steps 1 to 3 in origin mode)
criteria.action: reject the request, insert no row and create no local branch
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with message branch does not exist in repository or on origin

criteria.condition: a batch registration contains an element whose branch no resolution step finds
criteria.action: reject the request naming the first failing element and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with message patch[i]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin, where i is the zero-based index of the first failing element

criteria.action: for any registration of a branch found nowhere, return the identical 400 message in hub mode and in origin mode

requirements.title: Skipping the branch check
requirements.rationale: skip_branch_check must keep its meaning as an opt-out of every lookup and side effect.

criteria.condition: a registration element has skip_branch_check true, in either mode
criteria.action: perform no ref lookup, no fetch, no credential resolution, no local branch creation and take no workspace lock for that element

criteria.condition: a batch mixes skipped and non-skipped elements
criteria.action: decide each element independently, so that a skipped element does not change how its neighbours resolve

requirements.title: Batch registration
requirements.rationale: A batch must stay all-or-nothing for rows while resolution may leave harmless refs behind.

criteria.action: validate and resolve every element, in array order, before inserting any row

criteria.condition: any element's resolution fails with a missing branch, a fetch failure, a busy workspace or an internal error
criteria.action: stop at the first failing element and insert no row for any element
criteria.contract: HTTP 400, 502, 409 or 500 respectively; the patch table row count is unchanged

criteria.condition: a later element fails after an earlier element created a local branch or completed a fork fetch
criteria.action: keep the earlier local branches and fetched tracking refs in place
criteria.contract: A later registration of the earlier branch reports the resolution method local

criteria.action: run the duplicate-in-batch and already-registered checks after the resolution loop, so that error precedence is unchanged and a batch that answers 409 may already have created local branches
run resolution before the existence checks and the if_not_exists lookup, so a missing branch answers 400 before a 409 for the same request

requirements.title: Concurrency
requirements.rationale: Sync fetches origin under the workspace lock and hub pushes take no lock, so writes need the lock and a compare-and-swap.

criteria.condition: resolution needs to write a ref (an origin_tracking create or an origin_fetch)
criteria.guard: the local check of step 1 failed
criteria.action: take wslock.TryLock(slug) before writing anything and hold it until that element's resolution finishes

criteria.condition: the workspace lock has been acquired for an element
criteria.action: re-check step 1 before writing, and report local without writing if refs/heads/<name> now resolves

criteria.condition: wslock.TryLock(slug) reports the lock busy
criteria.action: insert no row and not wait for the lock
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error type workspace_busy and message another operation is running on this workspace; retry later

criteria.action: release the workspace lock before the database insert and on every resolution outcome, success or failure

criteria.condition: the workspace lock is held by another operation
criteria.action: complete registrations on the local path and for skip_branch_check elements without taking the lock

requirements.title: Audit of the resolution method
requirements.rationale: Operators need to see how a branch was found and to tell not-checked from no-hook.

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration with a registered hook creates a patch
criteria.action: emit hub.patch.create with metadata key branch_resolution set to local, origin_tracking or origin_fetch, next to the existing branch_name and position keys

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration with skip_branch_check true creates a patch
criteria.action: emit hub.patch.create with branch_resolution set to skipped

criteria.condition: no branch-check hook is registered
criteria.action: omit the branch_resolution key from hub.patch.create

criteria.condition: an if_not_exists request returns the existing record
criteria.action: emit no hub.patch.create event
emit no hub.patch.create events, as before this spec

requirements.title: Resolver hook contract and wiring
requirements.rationale: One resolving hook avoids two sources of truth and follows the existing hook pattern that avoids an import cycle.

criteria.action: define in internal/workspace/branch_check_hook.go a resolver hook type that takes a context, a slug and a branch name and returns a resolution method and a classified error, replacing BranchCheckFunc
classify hook errors as at least branch not found, origin fetch failed (including credential resolution failure), workspace busy and other, and map them in the handlers to 400, 502, 409 and 500

implement the resolver hook in internal/carrypatch, constructed from the git runner factory, the workspace root, the variable getter store.GetVariableValue, the origin credential resolver of 20_fork_patch_sync and an injectable single-branch fetch function, and register it from cmd/af-hub/main.go in place of the inline rev-parse --verify closure
keep the workspace package free of imports of carrypatch and the carrypatch package free of imports of workspace

criteria.condition: the resolver hook returns an error that carries no recognised classification
criteria.action: treat it as an internal failure and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

requirements.title: Documentation and CLI surface
requirements.rationale: Project steering treats outdated docs as regressions.

criteria.action: describe in the registration section the resolution order, the 400 message branch does not exist in repository or on origin, the 409 workspace_busy and 502 origin_fetch_failed responses, the skip_branch_check behaviour and the branch_resolution audit metadata
update the POST /workspaces/{slug}/patches description, its 400 description and the skip_branch_check property description, and add 409 and 502 responses
update the afc patch add entry and the --skip-branch-check flag text, and update the command's help text, to describe the new resolution behaviour
add no new flag and send the same request body as before this spec, so that the existing CLI test passes unchanged
leave docs/carry_patch_workflow.md unmodified

execution_paths.title: Operator registers a fork-only branch known to the clone in hub mode

steps.action: runs afc patch add for a branch that exists only as refs/remotes/origin/<name> in a hub-mode workspace
reads PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE (hub) and calls the resolver hook
finds no refs/heads/<name>, takes the workspace lock, finds the tracking ref and creates refs/heads/<name> with a compare-and-swap update-ref, then releases the lock
inserts the patch row, emits hub.patch.create with branch_resolution origin_tracking and returns 201

execution_paths.title: Operator registers a branch pushed to the fork after the clone in origin mode

steps.action: submits POST /workspaces/:slug/patches for a branch that exists only on the fork, with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE set to origin
finds neither local nor tracking ref, takes the workspace lock and resolves origin credentials with ResolveCloneAuth
fetches only +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name> from the fork and creates refs/heads/<name> at the fetched tip
inserts the patch row, emits hub.patch.create with branch_resolution origin_fetch and returns 201

execution_paths.title: Batch with a missing second branch is rejected without rows

steps.action: submits a batch whose first element is a tracking-only branch and whose second element exists nowhere
creates the local branch for element 0 and then fails to find element 1
returns 400 patch[1]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin and inserts no row
re-submits the first branch and the registration resolves it as local without writing a ref
submits a registration for an unresolved branch in origin mode while the fork is unreachable
attempts the single-branch fetch, which fails with a transport error, and returns an origin-fetch-failed classification
logs the error text, inserts no row and returns 502 origin fetch failed with error type origin_fetch_failed

execution_paths.title: Registration while a sync holds the workspace lock

steps.action: submits a registration for a tracking-only branch while a sync holds the workspace lock
finds no local ref, fails wslock.TryLock and returns a workspace-busy classification
returns 409 workspace_busy and inserts no row
submits a registration with skip_branch_check true, which is accepted without touching the lock or any ref

symbols.name: FetchOptions
symbols.signature: struct with RemoteName string, RefSpecs []config.RefSpec, Auth transport.AuthMethod, Tags TagMode

symbols.name: NoMatchingRefSpecError
symbols.notes: Assumed error for a refspec matching no remote ref; unverified and not used in the repo. An integration test against a real bare fork must confirm it; otherwise list remote refs.
